backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic implemented.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping project features to source files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short summaries of various frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and custom CSS variables defining theme colors, dark mode values, and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and script loading the main React bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component assembling all homepage sections and layout.
frontend/src/components/royal-flame/Foot: Footer with about text, quick links, hours, social icons, and bottom attribution bar.
frontend/src/components/royal-flame/Gall: Full‑screen lightbox overlay with navigation, keyboard support, and image counter.
frontend/src/components/royal-flame/Navb: Sticky navbar with logo, navigation links, reservation button, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/royal-flame/sect: Renders an about section with an image, story text, and feature highlights using icons.
Displays a grid of featured menu items with images, descriptions, and prices.
Shows an image gallery with clickable items that open a lightbox viewer.
Provides a fullscreen hero banner with background image, headline, and buttons that scroll to sections.
Presents location and contact details alongside a map placeholder.
Implements a reservation form with validation and a confirmation view upon submission.
Displays guest testimonials with star ratings in a grid layout.
Highlights key features of the restaurant using icons and brief descriptions.
frontend/src/components/royal-flame/Star: Displays a 5‑star rating with filled and unfilled stars based on rating value.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to user identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking using Dfinity’s AuthClient.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, custom OKLCH color variables, typography, and global layout settings for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and the Internet Identity provider before rendering.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color tokens, fonts, shadows, animations, and plugins including typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s design goals, required images, existing implemented features, and architectural notes for the Royal Flame restaurant website.
